reviews.title: Excellent product that gets the job done!
reviews.comment: I love these.  They're silent, sturdy and with solid air flow!  Their no frills flat black is just what I wanted...no RGB nonsense using energy, adding complexity and cost.  They're 4pin PWM case fans, so they are compatible with speed sensors and software and hardware controls.  They are immediately recognized by utility apps like "Fan Control".  Connectivity is, of course, simple and standard, but each fan also comes with a daisy chain attachment. These are the ones to get if you're just looking for reliable, silent, effective fan cooling!  I bought 9 and the all work great!
reviews.author: Marco

reviews.title: Quiet, Reliable, and Affordable
reviews.comment: These fans are awesome, and the price makes them even better. They’re super quiet, even under load, and push plenty of air to keep my system cool. Build quality feels solid, and installation was easy. For the cost, you’re getting performance that rivals more expensive fans. You really can’t go wrong with Thermalright. Definitely recommend if you want reliable, quiet cooling without breaking the bank.
reviews.author: Brandon

reviews.title: Great Value, But Can Introduce Noise...
reviews.comment: Needed to replace my original Lian Li OEM fans, as they started dying after 15 years in a high-dust environment. Pros: - 4-Pin connectors, allowing for custom fan profiles. - Passthrough cables, so that fans can be daisy chained. - Built in rubber pads to dampen vibration noise. - Seems to move more air than the original OEM fans. Cons: - While they are quiet, they do emit a low hum that's definitely audible. Final thoughts: other reviews mentioned missing screws, but I can confirm that matching black screws were included within my package. At full RPM, these things are definitely audible, but not loud. While I'll miss the whisper quiet performance of my Lian Li fans, it's hard to beat the value you get for a 3-pack with a few extra features, and if they last half as long as my old fans, it'll be worthwhile. UPDATE: I had to remove as star, as fans are now running at ~50% RPM after setting up a PWM profile and I'm sorry to say that two of the fans exhibit coil whine. While it's not loud, in a quiet environment, it's definitely noticeable. So if you already have quite a bit of ambient noise or don't care about an potential increase in noise, then it's hard to beat this value. Otherwise, if you need whisper quiet fans, I'd recommend looking elsewhere. UPDATE 01/08/2025: upgraded the motherboard (MSI B450 to ASUS B650) and the coil whine is gone, so culprit may have been the previous motherboard's implementation related to the fan curve, so I'll give back another star. While they may not be the quietest fans in my system, they are able to move air and are still running fine.
reviews.author: B. Goodman

reviews.title: Cools well, and PWM helps it stay quiet
reviews.comment: Bought these to replace noisy/dying fans on my Corsair 7000D case. The airflow is much better than the stock fans, and the fans are much quieter. I appreciated that I could also get just plain black color fans with no RGB lights, as my case and build is just about RGB free. The 4PWM cables was also the other selling point, that way I can setup my fans to be running dead silent and then ramp up as needed.  Because they have such good cooling, I never even notice the fans over the general noise of my computer.
reviews.author: JS
